title: Reconstruction of a finite projective-line trace from its Chern degree
statement: Let R be a commutative condensed ring object, A a finite commutative ring, N a positive natural number with N A = 0, and Y a Noetherian scheme on which N is invertible. Give a Diagram d on a family L of R-module lines, finite realizations eY and eP, a line isomorphism i:eP(L(P)) ≅ A_P(1), and a FiniteTracePresentation p [def-diagonal-finite-arrow-equations, def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-finite-realization, def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-quotient-line]. Define c to be the composite isomorphism p.q_square.derived.iso on the shifted line, p.Rq of the shifted single-line isomorphism, and transport along p.q_canonical. Define t=c.inv followed by eY applied to d.traceq followed by eY.derivedUnit. Define FiniteTraceChernDegree to be the equality of the canonical Chern component with the identity. If the canonical Chern component biprod.inr followed by geoP1TwistedMap followed by t is the identity of A_Y, then FinitePresentedTraceEquation holds with i and p. No reference, scalar compatibility, completed trace, or reduction hypothesis is needed.

source.place: paragraph (1), reduction of the trace; trace proof paragraph (1), inverse positive unit/Chern splitting

proof.text: Construct shiftedLineIso and the comparison c by composing the existing shift, single, line and full-unit direct-image isomorphisms. Define t by c inverse followed by the realized supplied trace. These are explicit constructions, not choices.

Use finiteLineComparison to put the positive line shifted by two in D≤-2, and finiteUnitComparison to put the coefficient unit in D≥0. Mathlib DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.zero makes the first summand of splitting.hom followed by t zero.

The hypothesis, rewritten by p.hsplitting, makes the second component the identity. Biproduct hom extensionality gives splitting.hom followed by t equal to the second projection. Cancel the splitting and c. By the definition of geoP1Trace the resulting equality is precisely FinitePresentedTraceEquation.

lean.statement:
theorem finitePresentedTraceEquation_of_chern [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0) (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y]
    (hY : IsUnit (N : Γ(Y, ⊤))) (L : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, Modules R X)
    (d : Diagram R Y L) (eY : FiniteRealization R A Y)
    (eP : FiniteRealization R A (ProjectiveLine Y))
    (lineP : eP.F.obj (L (ProjectiveLine Y)) ≅ geoCartierLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine Y))
    (p : FiniteTracePresentation R A N hN hA Y hY L d eY eP)
    (hchern : FiniteTraceChernDegree R A N hN hA Y hY L d eY eP lineP p) :
    FinitePresentedTraceEquation R A N hN hA Y hY L d eY eP lineP p
